mapper.select: SELECT A.APPLY_ID , A.POST_ID , A.USER_ID , U.NAME , A.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD , A.TECH_STACK_CD , (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM CMM_CODE_DTL WHERE COM_CD_ID = 'RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD' AND DTL_CD_ID = A.RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_CD) AS RECRUIT_POSIT_TYPE_NM , A.APPLY_REASON , A.PORTFOLIO_URL , A.STATUS_CD , (SELECT DTL_CD_NM FROM CMM_CODE_DTL WHERE COM_CD_ID = 'APPLY_STATUS_CD' AND DTL_CD_ID = A.STATUS_CD) AS STATUS_NM , TO_CHAR(A.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REG_DT , A.STATUS_CD FROM POST_APPLY A JOIN USERS u ON A.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE A.POST_ID = #{postId} AND A.USER_ID != (SELECT P.USER_ID FROM POST P WHERE P.POST_ID = #{postId}) /* 스터디장은 목록에서 제외 */ ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC
